text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Five days left until tryouts...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The shoes I ordered—ones durable enough
to withstand Oguri Cap's
devastating
power—finally arrived, so I head over to
give them to her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: New shoes? For me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...But why? I'm not even your trainee yet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I tell her about the conversation I had
with Tamamo Cross and how
tryouts are where
a student proves her true worth by giving
it her all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama said that? I see. So that's how
tryouts work.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Thanks for the shoes. I'll break
them in as I practice for the
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap accepts the shoes, after which I
decide to keep an eye on
her as she takes
them for a spin.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant... Huff, huff... Haha... Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This is amazing! My legs... are light as
feathers!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you again for the shoes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
They're... absolutely perfect.
I'll take good
care of them.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: H-huh? What—?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's no big deal... I think. It's just...
Uh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
What you said. It felt really...
familiar...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. Don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
In any case, thank you one last time for
the shoes. I promise to pull
out all the
stops come tryouts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Five days pass, and the time for tryouts
finally arrives.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running today is not only Oguri Cap but
also another student
rumored to be just as
fast and skilled—Super Creek.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The podiums are absolutely buzzing with
excitement.  If I didn't know
any better, I'd
think this is a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Wow. There sure are a lot of people here
today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Are tryouts always like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No, actually.
It's quite unusual to have this
large of an audience... I
wonder if there's
some celebrity here today.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A celebrity? That would explain the
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Tryouts Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, please get ready for the
race!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes, ma'am! I'll be right there!
I have to go
now.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: See ya.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Wait, who even was that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two are completely oblivious to all
the
attention they're
garnering. Although
maybe in this case, ignorance is bliss...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not that it matters.
Once they start racing,
the crowd roars with
excitement, and it's
clear why everyone's here today.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is closing the gap! She isn't
wasting a single second!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Almost there! She's taking the lead! But
wait! Creek is speeding up! Will she be
able to lose Oguri?! It's gonna be a close
match! Who will
win?! Oguri or Creek?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri ends up in second place behind
Super Creek, who won by a
mere fraction
of a second.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Second place... Huh...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I got brand-new shoes...
and ran as fast as I
could... But I still got
second...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
This place really is something else.
Once I
debut, I'll be able to race
even more rivals
like Tama and Creek...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: This is awesome... and exciting!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: Nice job, Oguri Cap! You were amazing!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Very impressive. I'm currently
looking to recruit more talented
runners to
train under my tutelage, if you're
interested...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah, right...
I need to get scouted before I
can make my debut...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but... Sorry,
I'll have to decline.
Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap awkwardly wades through the
crowd and makes her way
towards me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Did you watch the race?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Th-thanks.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Um... yeah, it has to be you.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I have a favor to ask. Would you be my
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
The guidance you gave and your words of
support... They felt
genuine.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Praise or criticism,
you're genuine like the
folks back home. It feels
nice. Really takes
me back.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Even though I'm far from home, as long as
you're my trainer, I feel like
I can ease my
mind and put my all into running.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So... how about it? Would you please be
my trainer?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Of course!
I wouldn't want anything less.
Let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: All right. First things first...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Growl...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Let's grab something to eat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With nothing other than food on her mind,
we depart in search of
sustenance. My
days of training Oguri Cap have only just
begun!
